MANUAL

dotnet

manual v0.1

Baseline guidance for designing and building software in C# on .NET: project and namespace boundaries, dependencies, entry points, types and nullability, exceptions, async and cancellation, interfaces and composition, configuration, external boundaries, and testing.

Adopt and deliver this manual

From an initialized project, adopt the manual explicitly, then deliver it at the project's declared user-scope skill targets:

garage config add manual dotnet
garage skills install
garage skills verify

The CLI delivers builder-garage-manual-dotnet as a skill. Installation alone does not make the guidance apply: the project's configuration must adopt it. Manuals are guidance, not workflow requirements or configuration files. See how manuals are used.
